{"content": "# Fresh Ideas Tracker

## Purpose
This document serves as a living repository for all new ideas, concepts, and innovations that arise within the team. It is intended to capture, organize, and prioritize ideas so that they can be reviewed, refined, and potentially implemented.

## Structure
1. **Idea ID** – Unique identifier for each idea.
2. **Title** – Short descriptive title.
3. **Description** – Detailed explanation of the idea.
4. **Originator** – Person who submitted the idea.
5. **Date Submitted** – Timestamp of submission.
6. **Status** – Current status (e.g., New, Under Review, Approved, Rejected, In Progress, Completed).
7. **Priority** – Suggested priority level (Low, Medium, High).
8. **Comments** – Additional notes or feedback.

## How to Add an Idea
1. Open this file.
2. Append a new entry following the structure above.
3. Save the file.

## Example Entry
```
Idea ID: 001
Title: AI-Powered Customer Support Chatbot
Description: Develop a chatbot that uses natural language processing to handle common customer queries, reducing response time and freeing up support staff.
Originator: Jane Doe
Date Submitted: 2026-06-23
Status: New
Priority: High
Comments: Needs feasibility study.
```

Feel free to adapt the template as needed.
